name: How much does it cost to hire a dog bite personal injury lawyer?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a dog bite personal injury lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most dog bite personal injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you typically don't pay any upfront fees or hourly rates. Instead, the lawyer's fees are a percentage of the final settlement or court award you receive. If your case is not successful, you generally don't owe any attorney fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without financial burden during a challenging time. It's important to discuss the specific contingency fee percentage and any potential costs like court filing fees or expert witness fees during your initial consultation.
